## Practical Tips for Choosing Quality Products

Choosing the right home organization products requires considerations that aren't always obvious. From our experience crafting dozens of guides for Sesoris readers, here are three principles most commonly overlooked.

First, pay attention to **material density**, not just visible thickness. Quality food-grade plastic has higher density than recycled plastic, making it more impact-resistant and crack-proof. Check the product's weight relative to its size, items that feel too light for their dimensions usually use thinner material.

Second, **stackability compatibility**. Many shoppers buy containers or organizers as a set, only to discover they can't be stacked neatly due to 1-2 cm dimension differences. Before buying, ensure exterior dimensions match across series so they can be stacked maximally in cupboards or pantries.

Third, **long-term maintenance cost**. A Rp 50.000 product that needs replacement every 6 months actually costs more than a Rp 200.000 product that lasts 3 years. Calculate total cost of ownership, not just initial price.

## FAQ: Frequently Asked Questions About Food Storage Containers Airtight
**Q: How long do airtight food storage containers typically last?**

High-quality airtight containers can last 5-10 years with proper care. Glass containers often last longest, while plastic containers may need replacement every 3-5 years depending on use frequency and cleaning methods.
**Q: Can I put hot food directly into airtight containers?**
Allow hot foods to cool to room temperature before sealing in airtight containers. Trapping hot air and steam can create pressure buildup and may warp plastic containers or compromise seal integrity.
**Q: What's the best way to clean sticky residue from container seals?**

Soak seals in warm water with dish soap for 15-20 minutes, then gently scrub with a soft brush. For stubborn residue, use a paste of baking soda and water, avoiding harsh chemicals that could damage the seal material.
**Q: Are expensive airtight containers worth the investment?**

Premium containers typically offer superior seal quality, durability, and warranty coverage. While budget options work well for basic needs, investing in quality containers for frequently used items often provides better long-term value.
**Q: How do I know if my airtight seal is working properly?**

A properly sealed container should have slight resistance when opening and you shouldn't be able to easily lift the lid with gentle pressure. You can also test by submerging a sealed empty container in water - no bubbles should escape.
